title: After nearly two weeks, the power is still out for more than 20,000 people in Gary, IN.
summary: We’ve talked about outages globally and power grid issues in the US, but the place feeling the worst of it has been northwest Indiana, ever since a derecho knocked out power for more than 300,000 people starting on August 11th .
